exposure: Side of rudimentary horn (left vs. right)
cohort: Patients diagnosed with rudimentary horn pregnancy at a tertiary center between 2008 and 2018
finding: The study found a decrease in the frequency of both rudimentary horn pregnancy and preoperative rupture of rudimentary horn pregnancy in the later time period, suggesting advancements in ultrasonographic technology and increased awareness among physicians.
mod_finding: This study found that the frequency of rudimentary horn pregnancy (RHP) diagnosis, both before and after rupture, has decreased, potentially due to advancements in ultrasound technology and increased physician awareness; however, it does not directly analyze mode of delivery.
